case.query: I have two separate questions: I was told my blood has too few platelets, which is called thrombocytopenia. What kind of health risk does this put me at? I recently took a course of antibiotics and now have a skin infection. Could the medication have made me more likely to get a fungal infection?
evidence: This can put you at risk for mild to serious bleeding .
You are more likely to get a fungal infection if you have a weakened immune system or take antibiotics.
